description: This is an HTML file for a web-based database viewer interface, containing structure, styles, and inline JavaScript for dynamic functionality related to database browsing and data visualization.
external_files: fetch API calls to endpoints like /api/databases, /api/{db}/tables, /api/{db}/tables/{table}/data

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the interface to initial state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds HTML for displaying table data with possible wide content handling.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Render individual cell content, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggle expanded view of cell content for long text or objects.
